front: A leather sack that opens to either a mundane space or a hidden extradimensional pocket, chosen by a secret command word.
back:
Mundane space holds 5 Bulk. Extradimensional pocket (Type II) holds 5 Bulk.
Searchers notice the magical seam with a DC 18 Perception check; Type II DC is 23.
Activate (1 action, command): speak a secret word to open either the mundane sack or the pocket. Interact to put items in or take them out as normal.
